description: One dashboard for fleet overview and individual-pod diagnosis. Workload=All and Pod=All show the combined selection; choose a workload or pod to narrow it. Include old pods adds retired replicas observed in the selected period. Compare workloads in the table; use Current pods to inspect a replica. Counters sum process observations after reset handling, percentiles use combined buckets, and shared balances are not added across replicas. Missing data remains unknown.

spec.title: CPU usage
spec.description: Values are shown per namespace/workload across matching scrape targets. Pod All aggregates the listed replicas by workload. Period counters add process observations; they do not deduplicate business events. Shared state and account balances are not summed across replicas.

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace((rate(process_cpu_seconds_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!=""}[$__rate_interval])) and on (namespace, pod) solver_bot_build_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!=""}, "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?"))

spec.title: Memory
spec.description: Values are shown per namespace/workload across matching scrape targets. Pod All aggregates the listed replicas by workload. Period counters add process observations; they do not deduplicate business events. Shared state and account balances are not summed across replicas.

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(max by (namespace, pod) ((process_resident_memory_bytes{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!=""} and on (namespace, pod) solver_bot_build_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!=""})), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?"))

sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(max by (namespace, pod) ((go_memstats_heap_alloc_bytes{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!=""} and on (namespace, pod) solver_bot_build_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!=""})), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?"))

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(max by (namespace, pod) ((go_goroutines{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!=""} and on (namespace, pod) solver_bot_build_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!=""})), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?"))

sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(max by (namespace, pod) ((process_open_fds{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!=""} and on (namespace, pod) solver_bot_build_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!=""})), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?"))

Pod All aggregates the listed replicas by workload. Period counters add process observations; they do not deduplicate business events. Shared state and account balances are not summed across replicas.

spec.title: RPC errors: what failed
spec.description: Bounded error classes by method. rpc_error is a returned JSON-RPC error (for example a revert), distinct from transport failure. Values are shown per namespace/workload across matching scrape targets. Pod All aggregates the listed replicas by workload. Period counters add process observations; they do not deduplicate business events. Shared state and account balances are not summed across replicas.

spec.title: Endpoint attempt counts
spec.description: Each endpoint ordinal is local to one workload and role. URLs are deliberately absent from labels. Values are shown per namespace/workload across matching scrape targets. Pod All aggregates the listed replicas by workload. Period counters add process observations; they do not deduplicate business events. Shared state and account balances are not summed across replicas.

Shared state and account balances are not summed across replicas.

spec.title: RPC success age
spec.description: Age since the last observed timestamp. A zero timestamp is Not seen; missing series stay empty. Freshness uses the oldest reporting replica; event age uses the latest event. Pod All aggregates the listed replicas by workload. Period counters add process observations; they do not deduplicate business events. spec.expr: clamp_min(time() - (min by (namespace, workload, role) (label_replace(solver_bot_rpc_last_successful_request_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!=""}, "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?")) > 0), 0) or ((min by (namespace, workload, role) (label_replace(solver_bot_rpc_last_successful_request_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!=""}, "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?")) == 0) - 1)

spec.title: Fallback overhead
spec.description: Selected-range counts. Extra attempts are endpoint attempts beyond logical calls. Values are shown per namespace/workload across matching scrape targets. Pod All aggregates the listed replicas by workload. Period counters add process observations; they do not deduplicate business events. spec.expr: sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(increase(solver_bot_rpc_requests_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!=""}[$__range]), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?"))

sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(increase(solver_bot_rpc_attempts_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!=""}[$__range]), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?"))

max by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(clamp_min(sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(increase(solver_bot_rpc_attempts_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!=""}[$__range]), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?")) - sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(increase(solver_bot_rpc_requests_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!=""}[$__range]), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?")), 0), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?"))

Pod All aggregates the listed replicas by workload. Period counters add process observations; they do not deduplicate business events. spec.expr: sum by (namespace, workload, label, outcome, address) (label_replace(((sum by (namespace, pod, label, outcome) (increase(solver_bot_txmanager_requests_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!=""}[$__range]))) > 0) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (address) (max by (namespace, pod, address) (max_over_time(solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!=""}[$__range]))), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?"))
